column3:
We always complain about the injustice of life. Someone doesn't get his dream job, his love, admission, or anything else. But one thing we need to understand is that these complaints arise from the belief that there is a fundamental rule in nature which is justice. What comes around goes around. But this is not true, nature never promised us that everything bad happen to you will eventually be compensated for. I believe fundamentally that this is not the case. We see many examples around us of evil people and they are happy and cheering their lives. I think Karma is just a story to sell to the weak, who can't take revenge or raise their voice for himself. That eventually everything will be balanced by some deity. And of course, this thing leads to hope, I don't know if it's a good thing or a bad thing, maybe a good thing for the weak or poor. Everyone can't live with this burden of truth that there is no one who will help him or will give compensation to him. The day you accept this fact that there is no inherent justice or injustice in nature and it is not necessary that you can get that thing for which you have done so much or hard work. So, does it mean we should stop doing hard work and do nothing and sit idle at home? Well no! Because justice is a human-made concept and we believe as humans that one should get what he has done so much hard work for; also there is no inherent justice doesn't mean it happens all the time. There is no rigid rule for that. So you always have to be well prepared. And also, if you truly don't understand that work itself is a thing to do irrespective of reward, salary, money or anything (but this thing is not for everyone to understand, normal humans don't operate on this principle). Do what you love the most, because in that case you are not looking for rewards and if you don't get it you won't complain because you already enjoyed too much. When you do the work which you don't like and you are waiting for the materialistic reward and then you will enjoy it, and if somehow you don't get it you will be demotivated. So, work just for the sake of work, don't work for the rewards.

Figure out what you like the most and then follow that passion restlessly, impatiently and in an unorganized manner.
